import {M78_CONTINUATION3_INTERRUPTION} from '../../tools/staging/check-m78-continuation3'
import {test,expect} from 'bun:test'
import {verifyDiagnostics,verifyBaseline,verifyCI,REQUIRED_CHECKS,DISPOSITION_PIN} from './m78-continuation3-baseline-independent-review'
import {m78CanonicalJson as canonical} from '../../packages/neuvetra-database/src/m78-validation'
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
const sha=(v:string)=>new Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256').update(v).digest('hex')
const seed=()=>{const es:any[]=[{kind:'phase_started',data:{failedBaselineSha256:'8525a8416b3e55f07d508c9a9ec17fc8ac0a4902e798534dc05e9f4df72d1a46',failedBaselineHead:'e766f74b730bebf69849945407598c011f918b9a77b7ff9c3a5913cd6964f744',journal:'.superpowers/m78-hosted-continuation3.jsonl',interruption:{...M78_CONTINUATION3_INTERRUPTION},disposition:{...DISPOSITION_PIN}}}];for(let i=1;i<=16;i++){es.push({kind:'request_intent',data:{ordinal:i,method:'POST',route:'auth:/auth/v1/'+(i<=8?'token':'logout')}});es.push({kind:'response_headers',data:{ordinal:i,status:i<=8?200:204,elapsedMs:1}})}es.push({kind:'phase_finished',data:{status:'passed',diagnosticsHealthy:true,paused:false,applicationPostRequests:0,allCreatedAuthSessionsClosed:true}});return es}
const freeze=(es:any[])=>{let previous:string|null=null;const lines=es.map((e,i)=>{const body={sequence:i+1,previousSha256:previous,profile:'m78-continuation3-diagnostic-v1',mode:'baseline',...e,createdAt:new Date(100000+i).toISOString()},hash=sha(canonical(body));previous=hash;return JSON.stringify({...body,sha256:hash})});const text=lines.join('\n')+'\n';return {text,sha:sha(text),head:previous!}}
test('diagnostic success pairs every header with intent and exact parent/phase/auth closure',()=>{const f=freeze(seed());expect(verifyDiagnostics(f.text,f.sha,f.head,16).requests).toBe(16);expect(()=>verifyDiagnostics(f.text,'0'.repeat(64),f.head,16)).toThrow();expect(()=>verifyDiagnostics(f.text,f.sha,f.head,17)).toThrow()})
test('rehashing cannot admit missing headers, application write, wrong status, parent or extra phase',()=>{for(const mutate of [(e:any[])=>e.splice(2,1),(e:any[])=>e[1].data.route='application:/workspace/:id/scope1-inventory',(e:any[])=>e[2].data.status=503,(e:any[])=>e[0].data.failedBaselineSha256='0'.repeat(64),(e:any[])=>e.splice(1,0,{kind:'phase_started',data:{}}),(e:any[])=>e.at(-1).data.status='failed']){const es=seed();mutate(es);const f=freeze(es);expect(()=>verifyDiagnostics(f.text,f.sha,f.head,16)).toThrow()}})
test('preserved actual failed24 fixture is never admitted as a completed baseline',async()=>{const text=await readFile('tools/staging/m78-continuation2-failed-baseline.jsonl','utf8');await expect(verifyBaseline(text,'',{journalSha256:sha(text),journalHead:'e766f74b730bebf69849945407598c011f918b9a77b7ff9c3a5913cd6964f744'}as any)).rejects.toThrow()})

test('continuation3 refuses changed interruption/disposition, paused or unterminated diagnostics',()=>{for(const mutate of [(e:any[])=>e[0].data.interruption.mainHead='0'.repeat(64),(e:any[])=>e[0].data.disposition.sha256='0'.repeat(64),(e:any[])=>e[0].data.disposition.path='wrong.json',(e:any[])=>e.at(-1).data.paused=true,(e:any[])=>delete e.at(-1).data.paused,(e:any[])=>e.pop()]){const es=seed();mutate(es);const f=freeze(es);expect(()=>verifyDiagnostics(f.text,f.sha,f.head,16)).toThrow()}})
test('exact tooling CI requires all six distinct completed check names at supplied commit',()=>{const commit='a'.repeat(40),ci=()=>({sha:commit,pr_head:commit,checks:REQUIRED_CHECKS.map(name=>({name,status:'completed',conclusion:'success'}))});expect(()=>verifyCI(ci(),commit)).not.toThrow();for(const mutate of [(c:any)=>c.sha='b'.repeat(40),(c:any)=>c.pr_head='b'.repeat(40),(c:any)=>c.checks[0].status='in_progress',(c:any)=>c.checks[0].conclusion='failure',(c:any)=>c.checks[0].name=c.checks[1].name,(c:any)=>c.checks.pop()]){const c=ci();mutate(c);expect(()=>verifyCI(c,commit)).toThrow()}})
test('preserved interrupted15 is rejected even with its exact supplied hash and head',async()=>{const text=await readFile('tools/staging/m78-continuation3-interrupted-main.jsonl','utf8');await expect(verifyBaseline(text,'',{journalSha256:sha(text),journalHead:M78_CONTINUATION3_INTERRUPTION.mainHead}as any)).rejects.toThrow()})

The diagnostic phase must bind the exact interrupted15/30 evidence and disposition, be passed, healthy and explicitly not paused, with every request paired and all main/legacy sessions closed. Read-only source collector returned exactly 166 source and six historical pins. No positive full actual baseline fixture was fabricated; full actual acceptance remains pending explicitly supplied closed evidence.

Only new reviewer/test/report/run/snapshot files were written. No existing artifact, actual journal, credential, host, provider, authentication, database, Git or shared ledger action was performed. No runtime operation or polling occurred. Inherited requested compute is unknown; registry preference is gpt-6-astra/high and observed model/effort are unavailable. Root independently reviews this preparation; it does not approve exercise or the full hosted lifecycle.
